added: One sheet that stays on the table from stocking to the takings; stocking and pricing as on the boards, drawn closer in steps to fit the room

The Wholesale Market as lanes of 3, 4, 5 and 6 boxes; buying as travel from the box to the shelf; a rival's whole turn as one move; the lorry unloading a crate into each lane; walk-ins turning face up one after another

The stalls in buying order with what each bought today; your shelf with what tonight does to each piece; awning strips on your shelf and on a rival's box

The bell: every stall's prices turn over stall by stall; the Favoured Trade question as its card, which travels to the tied price and stamps it
